title: Talking Point: How Often Do You Buy The Games Leaving Xbox Game Pass?
summary:
They're discounted, so why not?

Once a game is marked for removal from Xbox Game Pass, how often do you buy it? The thought crossed my mind whilst I was putting together our recent roundup of November leavers, and it made me curious to hear the Pure Xbox community's thoughts.

On November 15th, 1000xRESIST will vanish from all tiers of Xbox Game Pass. That means if I want to play it - and I believe I do - then I'll have to buy it. As is customary with games marked for removal, Xbox usually slaps on a discount until the deed is done and the game is gone. 20% unless it's been featured in a sale elsewhere.

title: Review: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - The First COD I've Cared About In Ages
summary:
Let sleeping dogs lie.

For many years now, I've felt like I knew exactly what to expect from a new Call of Duty game without ever needing to play it. When I do eventually get stuck in, because I'm a COD enjoyer deep down, they're usually par for the course: action-packed, testosterone-fuelled kiddie crack designed to overstimulate, lock you in, and keep you playing.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 surprised me, though. Activision's latest entry is so much more than my rather crass judgement would’ve suggested, delivering the best campaign experience I've had with the FPS series since World At War. What a corker this one is, let me tell you!
